## Specific task description

Task instruction: Position the medium-sized white serving bowl at the center of the gray plate.

Task description: The target is the medium white serving bowl on the left side of the table, and the receiving surface is the gray plate near the front center. Place the bowl in the center of the plate and release it.

Success criteria: The white bowl is horizontally centered near the middle of the gray plate and lowered to the plate’s placement height, not merely hovering above it; both grippers are open.

## Execution tips

- Consider an unobstructed rim section facing the plate, with one finger inside and the other outside the bowl to grip its sidewall. Keep finger pads on the wall below the rim and adjust the opening to local wall thickness and fingertip clearance to reduce slipping from the rounded upper edge.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are actually on the inner and outer sides of the bowl wall with enough contact depth. Avoid merely overlapping in the image while pressing above the rim and tipping the bowl.
- Keep the bowl opening facing up during transport, and lift its base above the plate rim before horizontal adjustments, avoiding contact that could tilt it or make it slip.
- Use the visible plate edges to judge whether the bowl is near its center. Let the bowl bottom gain plate support before releasing, and watch clearance between the outside fingertip and plate to avoid touching the plate first or displacing the bowl during withdrawal.
